summary: Servas is a self-hosted bookmark management tool designed to help you store and structure web links using tags, groups, and a dedicated queue for reading later. It provides multi-user support with two-factor authentication and includes companion browser extensions for both Firefox and Chrome. The project is licensed under the GPL-3.0 and combines Node.js and PHP components.
goodFor: This application suits individuals or small teams wanting to self-host their bookmark collections with browser extension integration and multi-user access controls.
watchOut: The codebase has an at-risk maintenance score, suggesting potential delays in security patches or bug fixes, and overlaps with many established bookmarking alternatives.
deployNotes: Because the application runs via Docker, you will typically need to configure persistent storage volumes for your saved data and set up a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
